backups.title: Backups of {guest}
backups.intro: Only snapshots (lum_*) and vzdump backups (note "lxc-update-manager") made by LUM. Your own snapshots and backup jobs are not shown and never touched.
backups.no_snapshots: No snapshots made by the update manager.
backups.no_vzdump: No vzdump backups made by the update manager.
backups.protected_title: Protected in Proxmox – remove the protection there to delete it
ask.delsnap_text:
{snap}

You can no longer roll back to it.
ask.delbackup_text:
Backup of {when}

It is removed from the backup storage and can't be restored any more.
ask.delhistbackup_text:
Backup on "{storage}" made before the {kind} of {time}

It is removed from the backup storage and can't be restored any more.
ask.delete_backup_failed: Could not delete the backup of {when}: {msg}
ask.backup_gone: The backup no longer exists on the storage – the entry is marked as deleted.
ask.restore_text:
Backup of {when}

The guest is shut down, replaced by the backup and started again if it was running. All changes since the backup are lost, and Proxmox deletes the guest's snapshots.
ask.restart_text: It is shut down and started again, so its services use the updated libraries (and a VM the new kernel). It is unavailable for a moment.
ask.restart_self: LUM runs in this container: LUM restarts with it, and this page reloads when LUM is back (about half a minute).
ask.rollback_text:
Snapshot {snap}

It will be shut down and started again afterwards. All changes since the snapshot will be lost.
ask.delhist_text:
The entry and its log are removed from the history.

A snapshot or vzdump backup made for this update is not deleted – it stays available under the Backups button of the container or VM.
ask.bulk_restart_text: They are shut down and started again, all at the same time, and are unavailable for a moment. Each restart gets its own log in the history.
ask.bulk_restart_left_one: {count} selected guest is left out (not running, or LUM's own container – restart that one with its own Restart button).
ask.bulk_restart_left_other: {count} selected guests are left out (not running, or LUM's own container – restart that one with its own Restart button).

clear.intro: All finished entries and their logs are removed. Running updates stay.

clear.delete_note: Deletes the {what} LUM made, for every container and VM it manages – they can't be rolled back or restored any more. Your own snapshots and backups and protected backups are not touched. Runs in the background (bottom right).
clear.keep_note: Snapshots and backups are not deleted – they stay available under each container's or VM's Backups button.
